Job Summary

Hi Folks We are hiring for RAG/ Agent Implementation Engineer (Python | GenAI | DevOps)

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: 2 - 4 Years

About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on engineer with experience in building and deploying RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and AI agents. If youve worked with Python, GenAI platforms (such as Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Copilot Studio), and have some DevOps skills, we d love to hear from you

Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and deploy RAG pipelines and AI agents using modern GenAI frameworks.
Work with Python and optionally with cloud-based GenAI platforms like Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Copilot Studio.
Integrate LLMs with vector databases, document stores, and external APIs as needed.
Support deployment and automation tasks, bringing in DevOps best practices for model and app deployment.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into end-user applications.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience with LangGraph, FastAPI, AWS Bedrock, and DevOps skills align with role.
